title: Regulating the BACH1/NCOA4 axis to disrupt UPEC-induced intracellular bacterial communities: Tailin patent formula alleviates bladder epithelial injury by inhibiting ferritinophagy and ferroptosis.
authors: Wang, Qiuhan; Wu, Zicong; Zhang, Yifan; Song, Zhiyong; Deng, Xingyu; Gong, Xuezhong
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过BACH1/NCOA4轴抑制铁蛋白自噬和铁死亡减轻尿路感染膀胱上皮损伤，属纯湿实验与临床机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Intracellular bacterial communities (IBCs), formed following the vesicular escape of uropathogenic Escherichia coli (UPEC), induce injury to bladder epithelial cells (BECs) and contribute to the occurrence of acute urinary tract infection (UTI). Tailin Patent Formula (TLPF) is a patented traditional Chinese medicine formulation used for the treatment of urinary tract infection (UTI) and has been shown to effectively treat UTI and inhibit UPEC vesicular escape. However, the molecular mechanism by which TLPF targets IBCs to alleviate BEC injury remains unclear. PURPOSE: This study aimed to determine whether TLPF alleviates IBCs-associated BEC injury and to investigate the potential involvement of ferritinophagy- and ferroptosis-related processes associated with the BACH1/NCOA4 axis. METHODS: IBCs in exfoliated BECs from UTI patient urine samples were detected using Wright-Giemsa staining and immunofluorescence. UTI mouse and in vitro infection models were established using the UPEC CFT073 strain. Inflammation response, IBCs, bacterial burden, and cell viability were evaluated by ELISA, immunofluorescence, CCK-8 and plate count assays. Bioinformatic, RNA sequencing analysis, and molecular docking were performed to identify key targets of TLPF. Oxidative stress and iron homeostasis were evaluated using malondialdehyde (MDA), ferrous ion assays, and ROS detection. Key proteins involved in ferroptosis and ferritinophagy were analyzed by Western blotting, immunofluorescence, immunohistochemistry. Mechanistic studies were conducted using dual-luciferase reporter assays, gene silencing, and pharmacological inhibition. RESULTS: Clinical analysis revealed a 35% (21/60) IBCs-positive rate in patients with UTI, and TLPF significantly reduced IBCs in exfoliated BECs. In UPEC (CFT073)-infected mice, TLPF inhibited IBCs, reduced bacterial burdens, decreased IL-6 and IL-1beta, and alleviated bladder injury. Bioinformatic and RNA sequencing analyses indicated involvement of antioxidant defense and ferroptosis-related pathways, with BACH1 identified as a candidate regulatory target. TLPF attenuated oxidative stress, intracellular iron accumulation, and lipid peroxidation, accompanied by altered expressions of markers related to ferritinophagy and ferroptosis pathways in vitro and in vivo. Dual-luciferase reporter assays suggested that BACH1 might influence NCOA4 promoter activity. Pharmacological inhibition of ferroptosis or autophagy, gene silencing of NCOA4/BACH1, and in vivo BACH1 inhibition also recapitulated the protective effects of TLPF. CONCLUSION: TLPF may protect BECs against IBCs-induced injury by regulating ferritinophagy and ferroptosis via the BACH1/NCOA4 axis. These findings suggest that TLPF represents a promising therapeutic agent for UTI.
abstract_zh: 背景：尿路致病性大肠杆菌（uropathogenic Escherichia coli, UPEC）逃逸囊泡后形成的细胞内细菌群落（intracellular bacterial communities, IBCs）会诱导膀胱上皮细胞（bladder epithelial cells, BECs）损伤，并促进急性尿路感染（urinary tract infection, UTI）的发生。泰林专利方（Tailin Patent Formula, TLPF）是一种用于治疗尿路感染（UTI）的专利中药复方，已被证明能有效治疗UTI并抑制UPEC的囊泡逃逸。然而，TLPF靶向IBCs以减轻BEC损伤的分子机制尚不清楚。目的：本研究旨在确定TLPF是否能减轻IBCs相关的BEC损伤，并探讨与BACH1/NCOA4轴相关的铁蛋白自噬（ferritinophagy）和铁死亡（ferroptosis）过程的潜在参与。方法：使用Wright-Giemsa染色和免疫荧光检测UTI患者尿液样本中脱落BECs内的IBCs。使用UPEC CFT073菌株建立UTI小鼠和体外感染模型。通过ELISA、免疫荧光、CCK-8和平板计数法评估炎症反应、IBCs、细菌载量和细胞活力。进行生物信息学、RNA测序分析和分子对接以识别TLPF的关键靶点。使用丙二醛（MDA）、亚铁离子测定和ROS检测评估氧化应激和铁稳态。通过Western blotting、免疫荧光、免疫组织化学分析参与铁死亡和铁蛋白自噬的关键蛋白。机制研究使用双荧光素酶报告基因实验、基因沉默和药理学抑制进行。结果：临床分析显示UTI患者中IBCs阳性率为35%（21/60），TLPF显著减少了脱落BECs中的IBCs。在UPEC（CFT073）感染的小鼠中，TLPF抑制了IBCs，减少了细菌载量，降低了IL-6和IL-1β，并减轻了膀胱损伤。生物信息学和RNA测序分析表明涉及抗氧化防御和铁死亡相关通路，BACH1被确定为候选调控靶点。TLPF在体外和体内减弱了氧化应激、细胞内铁积累和脂质过氧化，并伴随铁蛋白自噬和铁死亡通路相关标志物表达的改变。双荧光素酶报告基因实验提示BACH1可能影响NCOA4启动子活性。铁死亡或自噬的药理学抑制、NCOA4/BACH1基因沉默以及体内BACH1抑制也重现了TLPF的保护效应。结论：TLPF可能通过BACH1/NCOA4轴调节铁蛋白自噬和铁死亡来保护BECs免受IBCs诱导的损伤。这些发现表明TLPF是治疗UTI的一种有前景的治疗药物。
